newsitem.title: USA: American Bingo to expand in South Carolina.
newsitem.headline: American Bingo to expand in South Carolina.

text.p: American Bingo & Gaming Corp said Wednesday that it acquired the "Lucky Bingo" center in Charleston on June 1 as part of its expansion in South Carolina, and that it expects to announce further growth in the state in the near future, particularly on the gaming side.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company expects that its new bingo and video gaming centers there will have a significant impact on its financial results in the second half of 1997 and beyond.

American Bingo said that it will also open a bingo and video gaming center in North Augusta, South Carolina early in the third quarter of 1997, bringing the total number of bingo centers open, or in development, to 20, nationwide. The company said it plans to have 25 to 30 bingo centers open by the end of 1997 and 100 bingo centers by the year 2000.
The company had just four video gaming centers in operation at the beginning of 1997.
Management expects to finance its bingo and gaming center expansion through current capital sources.
American Bingo derives revenues from its bingo centers in Texas, Alabama and South Carolina, and also generates gaming revenues from its video gaming centers in South Carolina.
